notes: Screens: a 🗑 by each screen in the list on the left deletes it (a widget screen, if there's another, or a second calendar page) – widgets taken off it earlier go with it
The title bar’s groups say just Set up and Apps
While a change is being saved to Google: an hourglass and “⏳ Saving to Google…”, and nothing else can be changed until it’s saved
No more “No reply” messages when you come back to the window: background refreshes wait up to a minute and fail quietly (the dot goes red and tries again); saves also wait up to a minute
Quicker: the admin data no longer asks Google Tasks every time (kept for two minutes)
